drivers.rationale: Jobs are accepted and processed asynchronously
Concurrent transfers may vary with queued work
Transfers and job scheduling may evolve separately
A queued service can tolerate moderate complexity
Eventual job status is acceptable but must be explicit

scenarios.stimulus: Transfer credentials expire during multipart upload
scenarios.expected_response: Refresh scoped credentials safely without leaking secrets or bypassing access checks
scenarios.measure: Review expiry, renewal, and redaction paths in the credential boundary
